title: I Went to the Woods: Risk Assessment

I don’t really know what I’m looking for. Maybe I like the uniformity of the path I’m cutting in the water. Maybe I’m looking for smoke. Either way, it occurred to me on the last run out to the cabin that if I did see smoke, I’d be in trouble. That’s what the raft is for, but the raft is tightly secured to the hard top of my Hewescraft. The raft was a means to get to shore.
